development_basis: NumPy exploration on existing development data found that lag-four correlation plus half-weight signed power recovered every reference timing as a top proposal. This is tuning on development data, not held-out validation.
scope: Eight differential timing neighborhoods locally ranked using native-rate lag-product and power evidence, then one or two all-symbol blind CFO acquisitions and full-window fractional confirmations
algorithm_changes: The proposal FFT uses 4096/8192 bins at 2.5/5MS/s, never downsamples the native phase lattice, and only proposes eight neighborhoods. Native-rate complex correlation magnitude plus half-weight signed power correlation ranks their local cells.
CFO phase from a single differential lag is not trusted or used to narrow the search; development showed large errors on weak signals.
All-symbol fine acquisition avoids the additional alias introduced by an alternating-symbol mask. An equivalent FFT-output permutation removes per-input frequency rotations.
No tone threshold or decision gate is changed. Fractional confirmation still uses original IQ over the full available 20ms.
